newsitem.title: USA: Time Warner Cable to carry Fox in New York in pact.
newsitem.headline: Time Warner Cable to carry Fox in New York in pact.

text.p: Time Warner Inc. has agreed to carry News Corp.'s Fox News channel on its cable TV system as part of a settlement ending a rancorous dispute between the two media titans, the companies said Wednesday.
The settlement ends a year-long dispute between two global media powers, Rupert Murdoch, who controls News Corp., and Ted Turner, whose Cable News Network was acquired last year by Time Warner.
Time Warner had argued at the time that it did not have enough space on its system to carry Fox. But Fox executives accused Time Warner of trying to protect CNN from competition.
As part of the settlement, all outstanding litigation between Time Warner and News Corp. and between Time Warner and New York City will be discontinued, the companies said.
Other terms of the settlement are confidential, they said.
In early composite New York Stock Exchange trading, News Corp. was up 6 cents at $18.25 a share and Time Warner was up 19 cents at $52.875 a share.
